root_cause.text: The USB subsystem unanchors the URB before invoking the completion callback, so URBs resubmitted in esd_usb_read_bulk_callback() are not anchored to dev->rx_submitted and are never freed by usb_kill_anchored_urbs() in esd_usb_close(), causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in esd_usb_close()." The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted)` before resubmission and unanchors it on failure.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add URB anchoring to ensure proper lifecycle management and prevent use-after-free in USB read bulk callback.
intent_record.what: Added usb_anchor_urb call before usb_submit_urb, with early return on success and usb_unanchor_urb on failure; restructured error handling to unify non-ENODEV errors.
intent_record.how: URB is now anchored to dev->rx_submitted before submission, preventing premature freeing. Successful submission causes early return; on failure, the URB is unanchored before error handling. The error path now prints a message for all non-ENODEV errors (previously only for non-zero err).
